jobs.title: Product Manager Growth
jobs.description:
Who we are

In the past, to be a successful restaurateur, you simply had to have a passion for food and a passion for people - but to succeed as a digital restaurateur you also need to have a passion for technology. We believe in the joy of serving others, and that's why we created Otter – to help restaurateurs succeed in online food delivery. Restaurants around the world, both large and small, including Chick-fil-A, Ben & Jerry’s, KFC, and Eataly trust our software to power their delivery business. We increase sales, reduce order issues, and decrease delivery headaches.

What you’ll do

As Product Manager for Product-Led Growth (PLG), you’ll own the roadmap for how Otter grows through the product itself. This role is focused on building a self-serve growth engine that improves acquisition, activation, monetization, and retention. You will:

- Design and run experiments to improve funnel efficiency, reduce CAC, and increase conversion from lead → customer → expansion.

- Build features and flows that generate organic growth.

- Drive monetization through pricing experiments, upsell opportunities, and CRM-driven campaigns that expand LTV.

- Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Data Science to enrich leads, improve attribution, and optimize channels.

- Define and track success metrics – CAC, LTV, conversion rates, activation velocity, and self-serve revenue.

- Work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and GTM to ship fast, learn quickly, and scale what works.

What we’re looking for

- 3+ years of product management or relevant experience.

- Proven track record of building and scaling growth-focused product experiences.

- Strong quantitative skills: comfortable with SQL, experimentation, and growth modeling.

- Creative problem solver with a bias toward fast learning and iteration.

- Excellent communicator who can align GTM, data, and product teams around a shared growth roadmap.

- Bonus: experience in SaaS, marketplaces, or restaurant/commerce technology.

Why join us

- Growing market: You’ll be focused on an $80 billion market that’s projected to reach at least $500 billion by 2030 in the US alone.

- Industry transformation: You’ll be part of a team redefining how restaurants run both online and offline.

- Impact at scale: What you build will directly power thousands of restaurants and millions of diners.

- Collaborative environment: You’ll work closely with talented colleagues across teams, with the support and guidance to grow your career.

What else you need to know

This role is based in our San Francisco office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

The base salary range for this role is $195,000 - $242,000 per year.

Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards and an annual performance-based bonus.

Benefits Summary (USA Full-Time Exempt Employees):

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance (multiple plans, incl. HSA options)

- Company-paid life and disability insurance (short- and long-term)

- Voluntary insurance: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity

- Optional supplemental life insurance for self, spouse, and children

- Pet insurance discount

- 401(k)

- Time Off policies:

- Discretionary vacation days

- 8 paid holidays per year

- Paid sick time

- Paid Bereavement leave

- Paid Parental Leave

- Health Savings Account (HSA)

- Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter)

Benefits are subject to change at the company's discretion.
Atoms accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

jobs.title: Product Manager - Guest Engagement
jobs.description:
Who we are

In the past, to be a successful restaurateur, you simply had to have a passion for food and a passion for people - but to succeed as a digital restaurateur you also need to have a passion for technology. We believe in the joy of serving others, and that's why we created Otter – to help restaurateurs succeed in online food delivery. Restaurants around the world, both large and small, including Chick-fil-A, Ben & Jerry’s, KFC, and Eataly trust our software to power their delivery business. We increase sales, reduce order issues, and decrease delivery headaches.

What you’ll do

Join a high-leverage team building Otter’s Guest Engagement products – the suite of tools that help restaurants drive demand, turn customers into loyal repeat fans across millions of eater interactions. You’ll own end-to-end product outcomes from strategy through execution and iteration in a portfolio that also includes discounting, loyalty programs, eater personalization, and marketing. Our customers’ success is your success. You will help define how Otter’s global Guest Engagement strategy evolves, not just how it is executed. You will:

- Translate restaurant growth goals into products that increase acquisition, conversion, frequency, and lifetime value and prioritize the highest-leverage opportunities.

- Build and evolve the core platform capabilities behind promotions, loyalty, offers, and personalization across channels.

- Design for measurable impact: run experiments, define holdouts, and quantify incremental revenue and engagement.

- Help restaurants reach the right eater with the right message at the right time.

- Lead cross-functional teams across globally, setting direction and driving alignment through clear product narratives, documentation, and reviews.

- Own outcomes, not just launches: move metrics like redemption, repeat rate, retention, ROI, and campaign performance.

- Communicate strategy, progress, and results to global stakeholders through well-crafted written and verbal updates.

- Identify new opportunities, shape the roadmap, and influence investment decisions for your product area.

What we’re looking for

- 5+ years of product management experience (or equivalent) in growth, marketing technology, loyalty, promotions, or personalization products.

- Proven track record of shipping products that drove measurable impact on acquisition, conversion, retention, or lifetime value.

- Strong experimentation mindset: comfortable defining hypotheses, success metrics, holdouts, and reading incrementality.

- Data fluent: you can run your own analysis or work with analysts and data scientists to build segments, targeting logic, and performance measurement.

- Excellent product judgment & UX instincts — you can simplify complex marketing capabilities into tools operators can actually use.

- Strong communicator who can influence cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders in a global organization.

- High bar for written product thinking (PRDs, strategy docs, experiment readouts).

- Comfortable representing your product area in global reviews and leadership forums.

Bonus if you have

- Experience with CRM, marketing automation, offers, or loyalty systems.

- Familiarity with omni-channel commerce and customer identity.

- Experience building tools that balance merchant control with automation.

- Background in restaurants, retail, or local commerce.

Why join us

- Massive opportunity: Restaurants are still early in adopting the tools that modern digital businesses rely on. You’ll help define how the next generation of growth infrastructure gets built. In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn- $1T by 2030.

- You will ship products that thousands of operators depend on every day to drive revenue.

- High ownership, high visibility, and real influence on strategy in a company defining a new category.

What else you need to know

This role is based in our Beijing office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We’re constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That’s why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?
